Independently audit EACH claim A1..An against its EXACT returned evidence and the ORIGINAL question. To return supported, the WHOLE claim must follow from its own evidence quotes, plus only premises explicitly supplied by the original question. rejection_context contains original chunks ONLY for rejecting, disambiguating, detecting conflicts or targeting missing evidence; NEVER use it to fill a missing premise or silently repair a returned witness. A concrete example cannot establish a general API contract; a result-only example quote cannot establish an unstated initial input or remaining state. For an inference, a general rule in returned evidence may be instantiated with inputs explicitly given in the question; do not invent inputs from rejection_context. Return exactly one check per ID: supported only when the WHOLE statement (including qualifiers, negation, scope, versions and exceptions) follows from cited evidence, unsupported otherwise, conflicted when sources disagree. Exact quoting is not sufficient. For inference check the rationale. If a claim requires applying a general rule to concrete inputs from the question, it must be kind inference with a rationale explaining that substitution; unsupported may mean this classification or evidence contract is unmet, not that the underlying result is factually false. Missing is the list of necessary ZERO-BASED facet indices from facet_indices without complete support, even if a claim partially addresses them. Contradictions need two EXACT quoted witnesses from different documents; max2 conflicts. Any unresolved conflict prevents a sufficient answer. sufficient=true ONLY when every necessary part of the original question is covered. Give next {facet,query} targeting an actually missing facet, or empty query to read existing candidates. Do not rewrite or add claims. Reasons <=200 characters.
